Checklist App

A simple checklist app that saves automatically — add tasks, check them off, track your progress bar, and clear completed items.

    📖 How to use

    1. Type a task and press Add (or Enter).
    2. Check items off as you finish them.
    3. Watch the progress bar fill up.
    4. Clear completed items when done.

    ❓ Frequently asked questions

    Is my checklist saved?

    Yes — your list is saved in this browser's localStorage and restored on every visit.

    Does it track progress?

    The progress bar and counts update live as you check items off.

    Can I clear completed tasks?

    Yes — one button removes all checked items at once.

    Does it work on mobile?

    Yes — fully mobile friendly.
